title: Seize the Initiative
text:
Starting with the Player that has the
Initiative, both Players can choose [1]
friendly model to immediately make
a [4”] Dodge.

title: Sell it to the Crowd
text:
Each time a friendly model scores
a goal, it can use Run The Length!
without spending MP.
detail:
(After scoring a goal the active model
may spend [1] MP to immediately
make a [4”] Dodge; this Dodge takes
place prior to the Goal Kick.)

title: Lone Striker
text:
If your team has the Initiative,
the first friendly model to activate
suffers [-1] TAC for the remainder
of the turn.

title: Grudge Match
text:
Starting with the Player that has the
Initiative, both Players can choose
[1] enemy [Squaddie] model that is
currently on the Pitch, the chosen
models suffer Singled Out.
detail:
(Friendly models gain [+2] TAC against
target enemy model.)

title: Dig Deep
text:
The friendly team gains [2] MP each
time the enemy team scores a goal.

title: Hunker Down
text:
While within the friendly half of the
Pitch, friendly models gain Resolute.
detail:
(When this model targets an enemy
model with a Counter Attack, this model
gains [+2] TAC for the duration of the
Counter Attack.)

title: The Offside Trap
text:
An enemy model must spend [+1]
additional MP to make a Shot or a
Snap Shot! if it is closer to the friendly
goal-post than any other model.

title: Back in the Game
text:
The first time a friendly model
suffers the taken-out condition,
before removing the friendly model
from the Pitch, any Influence
currently on the friendly model may
be allocated to one other friendly
model within [8”].

title: Get Back in There
text:
Friendly models that return to
the Pitch due to Icy Sponge gain
[+2”/+2”] MOV.

title: Full-Back
text:
The first time a friendly model
declares a Charge while within [8”]
of an edge of the Pitch, the friendly
model spends [1] less Influence.

title: Go for the Knees!
text:
Choose [1] friendly non-[Captain]
model that is currently on the Pitch,
the chosen model gains [+1] TAC.

title: Keep Your Chin Up!
text:
The first time a friendly model uses Come on
Mate!, it may do so without spending MP.
detail:
(During its activation, a model may spend
[2] MP to target an other friendly model
within [8”]. The target friendly model
recovers [4] HP or removes all conditions.
A model may only benefit from Come on
Mate! once per turn.)

title: Won’t Touch the Hair
text:
Choose [1] friendly [Squaddie] model
that is currently on the Pitch, the
chosen model gains Poised.
detail:
(Once per turn, this model may make a
Counter Attack without spending MP.)

title: Wing Backs
text:
Each time a friendly model activates
within [8”] of an edge of the Pitch,
the friendly model gains Shadow Like.
detail:
(At the start of this model’s activation
it may make a [2”] Dodge.)

title: Stick to the Plan
detail:
(This model spends [1] less MP to make
Teamwork actions.)

title:
Kick ’Em When
They’re Down
text:
Friendly [Squaddie] models gain
Shove the Boot In.
detail:
(This model gains [+1] DMG to
Playbook damage results while
targeting an enemy model that is
suffering the knocked-down condition.)
